title: Driveway Tiles in Pakistan: Pavers, Grass Grid, Stone
excerpt: Compare pavers, grass-grid units and stone for Pakistani driveways: load, base, drainage, grip and what to ask before you order.
meta_title: Driveway Tiles in Pakistan: Pavers, Grass Grid, Stone
meta_description: Pavers, grass grid and stone driveway tiles compared for Pakistan's sun and rain: load, base, drainage and what to ask. Free sample.
answer_box: Driveway tiles in Pakistan must carry vehicle weight, drain rain and grip when wet. Interlocking pavers, grass-grid units and thick stone each suit different driveways. Choose by load, prepare a compacted base with a slight fall, test a wet sample and ask for a dated written quote stating the unit.
ai_summary: Driveway tiles for Pakistani homes include interlocking pavers, grass-grid units and natural stone, chosen by vehicle load, drainage and grip. A compacted, sloped base matters as much as the tile. Pak Clay Tiles, in Lahore since 1982, offers a free WhatsApp sample and a dated quote.

faqs.question: Which tiles are best for a driveway in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: No single tile is best. Interlocking pavers suit regular parking, grass-grid units suit drainage and a greener look, and thick stone suits a rugged finish. Match the piece to your vehicle load and check a sample.

faqs.question: How much do driveway tiles cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Prices depend on material, thickness, size, quantity, delivery, season and base work, and may be quoted per piece, per square foot or per thousand. Ask for a written quote with unit and date; Pak Clay replies with one on request.

faqs.question: Are pavers better than normal tiles for a driveway?
faqs.answer: Often yes. Pavers are usually thicker and interlock to spread vehicle weight, while thin tiles can crack under a wheel. Both depend on a well-compacted base.

faqs.question: Can grass-grid pavers take a car?
faqs.answer: They are commonly used for parking bays and light vehicle access, but suitability depends on load and base. Tell your supplier how often and how heavy the use is before choosing.
